# Ganesha blog

> Articles from Ganesha. Course: https://ganesha-devops.vercel.app/courses/course-fef607a922d4e2c33f19c94f

## Articles

- [How Much Does It Cost to Build an App with AI?](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/cost-to-build-an-app-with-ai/): What it really costs to build and host an app with AI when you're not a developer: a $0 setup, a real monthly bill, and the charges that surprise you.
- [How to Publish a Website You Built with AI](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/publish-website-built-with-ai/): You built a site with an AI tool. Here is how to get it online: the files you need, where to host it, what breaks after deploy, and what to check first.
- [Automate a Spreadsheet Report with AI (No Coding)](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/automate-spreadsheet-report-with-ai/): Turn a messy spreadsheet into a weekly report with AI, without knowing how to code. A 6-step walkthrough, a copy-paste prompt and how to check the result.
- [How to Write an AI Prompt That Builds What You Want](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/write-ai-prompt-build-what-you-want/): Learn how to turn a vague idea into a clear AI request, with a fill-in-the-blank template, a before-and-after example and a checklist to fix bad results.
- [What to Build First with AI: 3 Beginner Projects](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/first-ai-project-no-coding/): A good first AI project is small, finishable in an afternoon and easy to check. Three projects to build without coding, plus a step-by-step and prompts.
- [How to Test and Fix AI-Generated Code Without Coding](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/test-fix-ai-code-without-coding/): A non-programmer's loop for testing what AI builds, reading error messages and writing a fix request that works, with a copy-paste prompt and example.
- [How to Use AI Responsibly at Work: A 6-Step Checklist](https://kallasgabriel.github.io/ganesha-blog/how-to-use-ai-responsibly-at-work/): A practical guide to using AI responsibly at work: a 6-step checklist to verify accuracy, protect private data and know when a human must review.
